title: Nontrivial bubble and half-bubble extraction at unstable boundary scales for embedded free-boundary minimal hypersurfaces of dimensions two through six
source_title: Bubbling analysis and geometric convergence results for free boundary minimal surfaces
author: Lucas Ambrozio; Reto Buzano; Alessandro Carlotto; Ben Sharp
difficulty_reason: A localized free-boundary compactness theorem is transferred to Fermi blow-up coordinates with varying ambient metrics. Stability on half-scale balls forces smooth multiplicity-one convergence, while a larger unstable ball excludes planar limits and yields a diverging negative Jacobi eigenvalue; reflection supplies finite total curvature for half-bubbles.
